Asc-Seurat v3 uses RPCA integration by default and keeps Harmony as an alternative.

Prepare a CSV file with `sample_name` and `data_path` columns, then load it from the Integration tab. After integration you can cluster the combined object and run either standard DE, condition-specific DE, or conserved-marker analysis across samples.
